CreateDateSchema.description: The creation date of the object in ISO 8601 format

DescriptionSchema.example: This Module contains all basic mathematics tests.

LongDescriptionSchema.example: This Module provides comprehensive resources and assessments for mathematics beginners.

OfflineStatusSchema.description: Indicates whether the object is offline or active

OwnerNameSchema.description: The name of the user who owns the ILIAS object

PresentationTitleSchema.description: The presentation title of the object

FieldsParameter.name: fields
FieldsParameter.description: Comma-separated list of keys. Only the specified keys will be included in the response. Example: `name,description,date`.

FilterParameter.name: filter
FilterParameter.description: Advanced filtering with the format `filter[field.operator]=value`. Supported operators: `eq`, `neq`, `in`, `not`, `gt`, `lt`, `gte`, `lte`, `between`.

LimitParameter.name: limit
LimitParameter.description: The maximum number of results to return.

OffsetParameter.name: offset
OffsetParameter.description: The starting index of the results for pagination.

OrderParameter.name: order
OrderParameter.description: The sorting structure for results in the format field:direction (e.g., 'title:asc' or 'title:desc'). Direction can be omitted, default is 'asc'.

SearchParameter.name: search
SearchParameter.description: Search for results. Available formats: (1) `search=element` for substring matching across all records, or (2) `search[field]=element` to search within a specific field.

basic.description: The username and password to authenticate with the API.
